name: ION-12310 cloud-sdk Gap Impl (appianway AWS upgrade)
description: Implement the strictly-additive cloud-sdk-api/cloud-sdk-aws/commons gaps required by the appianway AWS v1->v2 (cloud-sdk) migration, per design doc cloud-sdk-api/docs/2026-07-23-sdk-gap-appway-aws-upgrade-design.md. Gaps: S-G2 (StorageClient metadata/content-type put+copy), W-G9.1 (Event.Builder annotations round-trip), W-G9.2 (6 MetaData.Projection + 9 Event.Token constants), X-G7 (MailContent/SES reply-to), X-G10 (EmailService raw-MIME attachment support), C-G6 + config-substitution (widen getConfigTransformer + PropertiesSubstitutionConfigProvider), X-G11 (null-safe SSM profile-file supplier). Decisions: single version bump 1.0.28-SNAPSHOT for the five+config; X-G11 as a SEPARATE bump 1.0.29-SNAPSHOT (boot-path modification, land last, independently revertible). Per-gap branches feature/ION-12310-<gap> cut from current feature-branch tip, squash-merged back (~6 commits). Commit messages ION-12310 only. Backup branch backup/feature-ION-12310-pre-sdk-gaps-2026-07-23 pushed to origin BEFORE any work. Consumer zero-impact gate: mvn -pl network,auth,registration,self-service-reports,tx-tracking,booking,visibility,webbl,booking-bridge,db-migration -am verify (no reactor). Review findings F1-F9 incorporated.

entries.summary: Scope, gap set, and delivery decisions for the cloud-sdk gap implementation (design approved, not yet started)
entries.detail:
Design doc: cloud-sdk-api/docs/2026-07-23-sdk-gap-appway-aws-upgrade-design.md (fully reviewed/approved; incorporates review findings F1-F9).

GAPS (all strictly additive to cloud-sdk-api/cloud-sdk-aws/commons; consumers on 1.0.27 unaffected):
- S-G2: StorageClient 3 default overloads (put bytes+meta+ct, put stream+meta+ct, copy REPLACE) + S3StorageClient overrides (+MetadataDirective import).
- W-G9.1: Event.Builder annotations field + setAnnotations + copy in Builder(Event) + assign in Event(Builder) ctor (restores shared round-trip; parseJson currently drops annotations).
- W-G9.2: add 6 MetaData.Projection (REPROCESS, SUBSCRIPTION_ID, DISTRIBUTOR_REST, ORIGINAL_IB_WORKSPACE_FILE, SPLITTER_FILE_SIZE, EVENT_PROVIDER) + 9 Event.Token (ORIGINAL_FILE_SIZE + 8 FTP_*) constants; exact values in design doc S5.1.
- X-G7: MailContent.getReplyTo() default + MailContentImpl.replyTo + SesEmailServiceImpl .replyToAddresses at L120 non-templated site (preserve try/catch, F6/F7).
- X-G10: EmailMimeUtils.createMimeMessage(from,to,cc,bcc,MailContent) new overload (multipart/mixed+attachments) + SesEmailServiceImpl.sendEmail branch to raw MIME when getAttachments() non-empty; simple path unchanged.
- C-G6 + config-substitution: widen ConfigProcessingServerCommand.getConfigTransformer private->protected; lift appianway VariableLookupProvider+ProcessedConfigProvider into commons as PropertiesSubstitutionConfigProvider.
- X-G11: SafeProfileFile helper + ParameterStoreClientFactory.defaultProfileFileSupplier ONLY (NO defaultProfileName - F1); credentials/region unchanged. Boot-path modification (F2).
- X-G8: NO CHANGE (ingestor keeps vc.inreach v1 signer). DynamoDB: NO SDK change (adopt existing DynamoDbAdminCommand appianway-side).

VERSIONING (decided 2026-07-23): TWO bumps. 1.0.28-SNAPSHOT = S-G2, W-G9, X-G7, X-G10, C-G6+config (single bump, README v1.0.28 heading). X-G11 = SEPARATE bump 1.0.29-SNAPSHOT (own commit, own README heading; boot-path change isolated & independently revertible).

WORKFLOW: backup branch backup/feature-ION-12310-pre-sdk-gaps-2026-07-23 created AND pushed to origin BEFORE any work. Per-gap branches feature/ION-12310-<gap> cut from current feature/ION-12310-commons-cloudsdk-refactoring tip; multi-commit dev OK; squash-merge back as one commit per gap (~6 commits). Commit messages ION-12310 ONLY. No rebase, no force-push (ordinary push). Consumer zero-impact gate (no reactor): mvn -pl network,auth,registration,self-service-reports,tx-tracking,booking,visibility,webbl,booking-bridge,db-migration -am verify (before+after). Library build: mvn -pl commons,cloud-sdk-api,cloud-sdk-aws,dynamo-integration-test verify incl DynamoDB Local ITs. WorkflowWireCompatTest must use REAL shared-produced JSON fixtures (F3) and assert inner annotations list non-empty (F4).

entries.summary: 1.0.28 gap set implemented with full test coverage; version bumped + README rolled; email blank-content-type bug fixed
entries.detail: Implemented full 1.0.28 gap set (strictly additive) on feature/ION-12310-commons-cloudsdk-refactoring. FILES CHANGED (main): (S-G2) cloud-sdk-api StorageClient.java +3 default overloads (put bytes+meta+ct, put stream+meta+ct, copy REPLACE) + Map import; cloud-sdk-aws S3StorageClient.java +3 overrides + MetadataDirective/Map imports, reusing existing validateInput/handleS3Exception/handleSdkException/handleUnexpectedException error pattern. (W-G9.1) cloud-sdk-api Event.java: Builder gains annotations field + setAnnotations + copy in Builder(Event) + assign in Event(Builder) ctor. (W-G9.2) Event.java +9 Token constants (ORIGINAL_FILE_SIZE + 8 FTP_*), MetaData.java +6 Projection constants (REPROCESS, SUBSCRIPTION_ID, DISTRIBUTOR_REST, ORIGINAL_IB_WORKSPACE_FILE, SPLITTER_FILE_SIZE, EVENT_PROVIDER). (X-G7) cloud-sdk-api MailContent.getReplyTo() default emptyList; cloud-sdk-aws MailContentImpl +replyTo @Builder.Default + addAttachment builder helper; SesEmailServiceImpl sendEmail(from,to,cc,bcc,content) applies replyToAddresses when non-empty (preserving existing try/catch). (X-G10) SesEmailServiceImpl branches to buildRawEmailContent (raw MIME) when getAttachments() non-empty, simple path unchanged; EmailMimeUtils new overload createMimeMessage(from,to,cc,bcc,MailContent) building multipart/mixed>alternative(text,html)+attachments-directly-under-mixed, To/Cc/Bcc headers, reply-to, null/blank content-type -> application/octet-stream. (C-G6) commons ConfigProcessingServerCommand.getConfigTransformer widened private->protected. (config-subst) commons new PropertiesSubstitutionConfigProvider (ConfigurationSourceProvider) resolving ${key}/${key:-default} env-first-then-properties, recursive chains, fail-fast on unresolved, leaves ${awsps:...} for downstream ParameterStoreConfigTransform; loadClasspathProperties helper; package-private env-injection ctor for tests. VERSION: root pom.xml dependency.version 1.0.27->1.0.28-SNAPSHOT; README rollover per 13.5 (demoted v1.0.27 paragraph, new ### Commons v1.0.28-SNAPSHOT heading with 5 notes). TESTS ADDED: S3StorageClientMetadataTest (put/copy meta, null/blank handling, interface-default fallback stub), EventBuilderAnnotationsTest (serialize, parse retains inner list non-empty & equal F4, byte-stable with/without, copy-ctor), WorkflowConstantsParityTest (15 value asserts + key round-trip), WorkflowWireCompatTest (external shared-format fixtures under src/test/resources/wire F3: cross-lib parity, byte-stable trees, timestamp pattern, annotations wrapper shape, new projection/token keys), SesEmailReplyToAndAttachmentTest (reply-to default/populated/interface-default, attachment->raw, no-attachment->simple, multi, octet-stream fallback, attachment+replyto, F8 recipient-source agreement), EmailMimeUtilsMailContentTest (mixed layout, attachment under mixed, octet fallback, reply-to), MailContentImplTest +3 (replyTo default/populated, addAttachment helper), PropertiesSubstitutionConfigProviderTest (10: property/chain resolution, env precedence, defaults, unresolved throws, awsps passthrough + ParameterStore integration, classpath load). BUG FOUND+FIXED during build: EmailMimeUtils used Strings.isNullOrEmpty which let whitespace-only content-type through -> javax.mail ParseException; changed to null-or-isBlank check (matches design null/blank->octet-stream). X-G11 NOT touched (deferred to 1.0.29). No git commit/push done yet (left for user review); local backup branch backup/feature-ION-12310-pre-sdk-gaps-2026-07-23 exists.

entries.detail: Post-review hardening round (2026-07-24), still within 1.0.28 set (no version change). FIX 1 (behavior, should-fix): duplicate Reply-To header on attachment path. SesEmailServiceImpl.sendEmail now applies requestBuilder.replyToAddresses(...) ONLY when !hasAttachments; raw path carries reply-to solely inside MIME (EmailMimeUtils) => single source, no duplicate Reply-To. Rewrote SesEmailReplyToAndAttachmentTest.attachmentAndReplyToComposeTogether to assert request.hasReplyToAddresses()==false AND parse raw MIME Reply-To header == reply@example.com. FIX 2 (minor): added Lombok-coupling javadoc note on MailContentImpl.MailContentImplBuilder.addAttachment (attachments$value/$set tied to @Builder.Default). FIX 4 (minor): javadoc on PropertiesSubstitutionConfigProvider.buildLookup documenting literal env-key lookup (dotted ${db.host} won't resolve from env; normalize if shared does). FIX 5 (nit): javadoc edge-case note on validateNoUnresolvedPlaceholders (literal ${...} in resolved value false-positives). Items 3 (fixtures) and 6 (Session.getDefaultInstance) = no action per user. IDE NPE/null-conversion warnings fixed via null-safety: WorkflowWireCompatTest.fixture uses Objects.requireNonNull on getResourceAsStream; SesEmailReplyToAndAttachmentTest adds rawBytes(request) requireNonNull helper + captureRequest returns requireNonNull(getValue()); EventBuilderAnnotationsTest uses requireNonNull on toJsonString and getAnnotations locals. Re-verified GREEN: cloud-sdk-aws email tests 44, cloud-sdk-api workflow 29, commons config 10. Build ordering note discovered: commons compile-depends on cloud-sdk-aws:1.0.28, so refreshing artifacts requires installing all four modules (order cloud-sdk-api -> dynamo-integration-test -> cloud-sdk-aws -> commons) before per-module test runs.
